name: Conspiracy Theorist

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, you may pay {1} and discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, you may exile one of them from your graveyard. If you do, you may cast it this turn.

notes: APPROXIMATION: the discard half of "pay {1} and discard a card" is a cost, and `optional-pay` carries only mana, so it is written as "you may pay {1}; if you do, discard a card, then draw a card" — the same choice, resolved rather than paid. The second trigger exiles a chosen card from your graveyard and `play-exiled` marks what the move bound as castable this turn.

issues: Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, you may exile ONE OF THEM from your graveyard. — expected Only the cards discarded by that event may be exiled. — scripted move {what:{filter:{}, zone:'graveyard', who:'you', count:1, choose:'you'}} — an EMPTY filter over your whole graveyard, so any card at all (a creature milled last turn, a land) can be exiled and then cast this turn. Materially stronger than the card. — CR 608.2, 109.5 ('them' = the discarded cards)

Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, ... — expected one trigger per discard EVENT, however many cards it discarded — scripted event {on:'discard', filter:{notTypes:['Land']}} — game.ts:1947 calls queueTriggers('discard') once per card, so discarding three nonland cards puts three copies of the ability on the stack. — CR 603.2

Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {1} and discard a card. If you do, draw a card. — expected Paying {1} AND discarding a card is a single cost: with an empty hand the cost cannot be paid, so no draw. — scripted optional-pay {mana {1}, then:[discard 1, draw 1]} — game.ts:1194 asks only whether you can pay the mana; with an empty hand the discard does nothing and you still draw. Cost turned into a resolution effect (documented in notes, but it changes what is legal). — CR 601.2h, 118.3

Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {1} and discard a card. If you do, draw a card. — expected Paying {1} AND discarding a card is one cost; with an empty hand the cost cannot be paid and you draw nothing. — scripted optional-pay {mana:{1}} then discard 1 then draw 1 as resolution effects. game.ts:1336 `const n = Math.min(amt, pl.hand.length); if (!n) continue;` — with an empty hand you pay {1}, discard nothing, and still draw. Free card the printed card never gives. — CR CR 601.2h, 118.4

Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, you may exile ONE OF THEM from your graveyard. — expected The exile is restricted to the cards just discarded by that event. — scripted move {what:{filter:{}, zone:'graveyard', who:'you', count:1, choose:'you'}} to exile — ANY card in your graveyard may be exiled (including a land, or something milled ten turns ago), then play-exiled makes it castable. A substantial broadening. — CR CR 701.9a

Whenever you discard ONE OR MORE nonland cards — expected One trigger per discard event, however many cards it discarded. — scripted event {on:'discard', filter:{notTypes:['Land']}}; Game.discard (game.ts:1947) calls queueTriggers('discard') once PER CARD, so discarding three nonland cards gives three triggers and three exile/cast permissions. — CR CR 603.2

If you do, you may cast it this turn. — expected Permission to CAST (a land could not be played this way). — scripted play-exiled {until:'eot'} sets castableFromExile, which permits playing the card (a land included) — a difference only because the exile source above was left unrestricted. — CR CR 601.1, 305.1
